versions.subject: Eighteenth Amendment 2010-04-19 Asif Ali Zardari
versions.content:
| Title        | Right to fair trial |
| ------------ | ------------------- |
| First Added  | 19 April 2010       |
| Last Updated | 19 April 2010       |
| Source       | https://pakistani.org/pakistan/constitution/amendments/18amendment.html |
| Amendment 18 | https://pakistani.org/pakistan/constitution/amendments/18amendment.html |

For the determination of his civil rights and obligations or in any criminal charge against him a person shall be entitled to a fair trial and due process.
